market_summary: <cite index="2-1,2-2,2-3,2-4">Singapore's three big banks delivered mixed Q3 2026 results: DBS reported a 5% year-on-year profit decline to S$2.81 billion missing expectations, UOB reported a 182% surge to S$1.25 billion but missed the S$1.38 billion forecast, and OCBC was the only winner with S$2.04 billion profit up 3% year-on-year beating analyst estimates

items.headline: DBS Q3 2026 profit down 5% YoY to S$2.81 billion, misses forecast
items.summary: <cite index="2-3">DBS reported third-quarter net profit of S$2.81 billion, a 5% year-on-year decline missing analysts' expectations of S$2.95 billion</cite>.

items.headline: UOB Q3 2026 profit surges 182% but misses forecast at S$1.25 billion
items.summary: <cite index="2-2">UOB reported a 182% year-on-year increase in third-quarter net profit to S$1.25 billion, although this missed analysts' expectations of S$1.38 billion</cite>.

items.headline: OCBC Q3 2026 net profit beats at S$2.04 billion, up 3% YoY
items.summary: <cite index="4-3">OCBC reported Q3 2026 net profit of S$2.04 billion — up 3% year-on-year and the only Singapore bank to beat analyst estimates this quarter</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore banks see strong AI financing demand but remain cautious on debt risks
items.summary: <cite index="2-5">UOB said AI-related financing accounts for less than 5% of its loan book, while DBS had about S$14.6 billion in data centre-related exposures, including S$8.98 billion in outstanding loans</cite>.

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's ties to China spark Washington scrutiny; board launches investigation
items.summary: <cite index="21-3,21-4">In November 8 email, Huang acknowledged infidelity to his wife; Nvidia's board announced independent investigation into reports CEO was target of foreign intelligence effort</cite>. <cite index="21-9">Trump said FBI is looking into the matter</cite>.

items.headline: House Republicans demand answers from Nvidia CEO over China spy allegation
items.summary: <cite index="20-1,20-2">Three powerful House Republicans are pressing Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for answers about ties to businesswoman suspected of spying for China; congressional scrutiny follows NY Times report of 'close' relationship with Alice Huang</cite>.

items.headline: Nvidia shares fall 4.2% as CEO scandal compounds Washington pressure
items.summary: <cite index="24-9">Shares of Nvidia closed down 4.2% in Monday's trading</cite>. <cite index="27-9">Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon pointed out that the incident will increase scrutiny of Nvidia in Washington</cite>.

items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway accelerates Q3 buybacks to S$9.6 billion, signaling belief in own valuation
items.summary: <cite index="32-5,32-6">Berkshire accelerated stock repurchases in Q3 as new CEO Greg Abel showed greater willingness to use its cash hoard than Warren Buffett, buying back S$9.6 billion of stock in quarter, on top of S$4.8 billion earlier in year</cite>.

items.headline: Berkshire Q3 operating profit falls 6% to S$12.71 billion as insurance underwriting weakens
items.summary: <cite index="34-3,34-6">Berkshire reported lower third-quarter profit with operating earnings down 6% to S$12.71 billion and profit from insurance declined 26%, with underwriting down 43%</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines invests S$2 billion in next-generation cabin seats and amenities
items.summary: <cite index="41-3,41-4">Singapore Airlines is rolling out new onboard seating as part of over S$2 billion investment to keep up with rivals, with cornerstone being new premium cabin seats for long-haul flights progressively debuting on Airbus A350 planes in mid-2027</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines unveils largest double bed and sliding doors in industry-first cabin redesign
items.summary: <cite index="44-1,44-2">Airline unveiled new cabins in all four travel classes in biggest overhaul in history with new seats due second half 2027; in first class, centre seats convert into what Singapore Airlines calls largest double bed in commercial aviation</cite>.

items.headline: Alphabet stock down 8.8% year-to-date as valuation concerns persist
items.summary: <cite index="15-4,15-5">Alphabet stock closed at S$282.57 on November 5, 2026, 20.1% below October 13 close; worst decline in single session Oct 29 when shares lost 12.6%</cite>.
